in_sanskrit.name: दयाशंकर
in_sanskrit.meaning: दया (dayā) - compassion, kindness; शंकर (śankara) - Lord Shiva
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who bestows compassion and kindness (Daya) and is identified with Lord Shiva (Śankara)

in_hindi.name: दयाशंकर
in_hindi.meaning: दया (dayā) - द्यूढ प्रेम, प्रसन्नता (dyūdha prema, prasannatā) - deep love, contentment; शंकर (śankara) - शिव (śiva) - Lord Shiva
in_hindi.long_meaning: The one who bestows deep love and contentment (dayā) and is identified with Lord Shiva (śankara or śiva)

in_tamil.name: தயாஷங்கர்
in_tamil.meaning: தயா (tayā) - அன்பு (anbu) - love, affection; ஷங்கர் (ṣaṅkar) - ஷிவா (ṣivā) - Lord Shiva
in_tamil.long_meaning: The one who bestows love and affection (tayā) and is identified with Lord Shiva (ṣaṅkar or ṣivā)

in_telugu.name: దయశంఖర్
in_telugu.meaning: దయ (daya) - ప్రేమ (premam) - love; శంఖర్ (śaṅkhar) - శివ (śiva) - Lord Shiva
in_telugu.long_meaning: The one who bestows love (daya) and is identified with Lord Shiva (śaṅkhar or śiva)

in_marathi.name: Dayashankar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God's gift, grace of Shankar
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dayashankar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Daya - grace, boon, gift; Shankar - Shiva, the god of destruction and creation. The name Dayashankar means 'God's gift' or 'grace of Shankar'.

in_bengali.name: Dayashankar
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ God's gift, grace of Shankar
in_bengali.long_meaning: Dayashankar একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Daya - grace, boon, gift; Shankar - Shiva, the god of destruction and creation. The name Dayashankar means 'God's gift' or 'grace of Shankar'.
